sentences.zh: 我妈妈和她的双胞胎姐妹，她们已经收拾好了我的衣服。

sentences.en: They put me in that car and took me to North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 她们把我塞进车里，带到了北卡罗来纳州。

sentences.en: So DeVetta takes Toby out of school and drives her down there.
sentences.zh: 于是德维塔让托比退学，开车把她送到了那里。

sentences.en: Were you mad?
sentences.zh: 你当时生气吗？

sentences.en: Of course I was.
sentences.zh: 我当然生气。

sentences.en: They took me away with my boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 她们把我从男朋友身边带走了。

sentences.en: My first everything.
sentences.zh: 我的初恋，我的一切。

sentences.en: He used to beat the mess out of me.
sentences.zh: 他以前经常把我往死里打。

sentences.en: He used to beat me out bad.
sentences.zh: 他打我打得很凶。

sentences.en: I'm glad they removed me because I was chasing that out of the world so bad.
sentences.zh: 我很庆幸她们把我带走了，因为我当时太沉迷于那种生活了。

sentences.en: Why did you want it?
sentences.zh: 你为什么想要那种生活？

sentences.en: Because they stuck together.
sentences.zh: 因为他们总是黏在一起。

sentences.en: And they put her in school in North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 她们把她送进了北卡罗来纳州的学校。

sentences.en: And she finishes high school there in North Carolina with honors.
sentences.zh: 她在北卡罗来纳州以优异的成绩完成了高中学业。

sentences.en: But as soon as she graduated, she made a beeline back to Baltimore.
sentences.zh: 但她一毕业，就马不停蹄地回到了巴尔的摩。

sentences.en: So she came home, came back to Baltimore and been held on wheels ever since.
sentences.zh: 所以她回家了，回到了巴尔的摩，从此就一直过着动荡的生活。

sentences.en: So did you?
sentences.zh: 那你呢？

sentences.en: So what happened then?
sentences.zh: 后来发生了什么？

sentences.en: I became a Baltimore fan.
sentences.zh: 我成了巴尔的摩的死忠。

sentences.en: What does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思？

sentences.en: I came and jumped straight into the drug gang.
sentences.zh: 我回来后直接跳进了毒品团伙里。

sentences.en: She was running the street.
sentences.zh: 她在街头混迹。

sentences.en: She would leave for two or three days, a week.
sentences.zh: 她会离家两三天，甚至一周。

sentences.en: Back to her boyfriend Donald, the streets, and the absolute peak of the crack epidemic.
sentences.zh: 回到她男朋友唐纳德身边，回到街头，正值快克可卡因泛滥的巅峰时期。

sentences.en: And Donald, by that point, the early 1990s, was a really important person.
sentences.zh: 而唐纳德，到那时，也就是九十年代初，已经是个很有权势的人了。

sentences.en: He was rich.
sentences.zh: 他很有钱。

sentences.en: He had a car.
sentences.zh: 他有车。

sentences.en: He bought other people cars.
sentences.zh: 他还给别人买车。

sentences.en: He bought Toby a car.
sentences.zh: 他给托比买了一辆车。

sentences.en: And she fell into life with him.
sentences.zh: 她就这样陷入了与他的生活中。

sentences.en: It started off, he was so jealous, I thought it was cute.
sentences.zh: 刚开始，他非常嫉妒，我以为那很可爱。

sentences.en: I mean, he loved me so much.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他太爱我了。

sentences.en: It was a very isolating life for her.
sentences.zh: 那对她来说是一种非常与世隔绝的生活。

sentences.en: He cut off all of her friendships, didn't allow her to see people, would even sometimes lock her in the house.
sentences.zh: 他切断了她所有的社交，不让她见人，有时甚至把她锁在屋里。

sentences.en: And then he made it to where he was my only friend, because I couldn't have no friends.
sentences.zh: 后来他让我成了他唯一的朋友，因为我不能有任何其他朋友。

sentences.en: So that didn't turn out good.
sentences.zh: 所以那段经历并不美好。

sentences.en: Sometimes we wouldn't hear from her for months.
sentences.zh: 有时我们几个月都听不到她的消息。

sentences.en: You know how they had missing persons?
sentences.zh: 你知道他们是怎么发布失踪人口信息的吗？

sentences.en: WBAL Television, Baltimore.
sentences.zh: WBAL电视台，巴尔的摩。

sentences.en: I used to look at nude just to see if I'd seen something happen to her, because she wouldn't call us.
sentences.zh: 我过去常盯着电视看，就为了看看是不是能看到她出了什么事，因为她根本不给我们打电话。

sentences.en: Because back then, you know, we didn't have cell phones.
sentences.zh: 因为那时候，你知道，我们还没有手机。

sentences.en: So we had to have the house phone.
sentences.zh: 所以我们只能守着家里的电话。

sentences.en: So I would just wait for the call.
sentences.zh: 所以我只能等着电话响。

sentences.en: The call never came.
sentences.zh: 但电话从未打来。

sentences.en: It worried me terrible.
sentences.zh: 我担心得要命。

sentences.en: But after that first year, I had to get my life together.
sentences.zh: 但在那第一年之后，我必须振作起来。

sentences.en: I was like, I can't sit here worrying myself to death.
sentences.zh: 我想，我不能坐在这里担心到死。

sentences.en: And she's not trying to get in contact.
sentences.zh: 而且她根本不想联系我们。

sentences.en: I don't know where she is, what she's doing or anything.
sentences.zh: 我不知道她在哪里，在做什么，什么都不知道。

sentences.en: How is she surviving?
sentences.zh: 她是怎么活下来的？

sentences.en: How is she living?
sentences.zh: 她是怎么生活的？

sentences.en: Because guess what?
sentences.zh: 因为你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: I'm not going to not know if my child is an abusive relationship or not, because I'm not spending that much time away from my child.
sentences.zh: 我绝不能不知道我的孩子是否处于虐待关系中，因为我不能离开我的孩子那么久。

sentences.en: So if she didn't know, she should have known.
sentences.zh: 所以如果她不知道，那她也该知道。

sentences.en: You don't get no paces with me, because I was your child.
sentences.zh: 你别想在我这儿找借口，因为我曾经是你的孩子。

sentences.en: You were supposed to protect me.
sentences.zh: 你本该保护我的。

sentences.en: And that's why we don't get along.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们合不来的原因。

sentences.en: I love her.
sentences.zh: 我爱她。

sentences.en: I respect her.
sentences.zh: 我尊重她。

sentences.en: I'll do anything for my mother.
sentences.zh: 为了我妈妈，我什么都愿意做。

sentences.en: But I was raising my child different.
sentences.zh: 但我养育孩子的方式和她不同。

sentences.en: After she'd spent probably what amounted to a couple of years in this situation,
sentences.zh: 在她经历了大概几年的那种生活后，

sentences.en: she just decided that just physically she could not take it anymore.
sentences.zh: 她决定在身体上她实在无法再忍受下去了。

sentences.en: And the story she tells is that she walked out of the apartment,
sentences.zh: 她讲述的故事是，她走出了公寓，

sentences.en: went to the bus station, got on a Greyhound bus, and went to North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 去了汽车站，坐上了灰狗巴士，去了北卡罗来纳州。

sentences.en: She had to leave Baltimore to get away from him.
sentences.zh: 她必须离开巴尔的摩才能摆脱他。

sentences.en: So it was like nothing to go down there and get unemployment.
sentences.zh: 所以去那边领失业救济金根本不算什么。

sentences.en: I just do what she had to do.
sentences.zh: 我只是做了她必须做的事。

sentences.en: I met this guy.
sentences.zh: 我遇到了这个男人。

sentences.en: Back in North Carolina, she meets another guy.
sentences.zh: 回到北卡罗来纳州后，她又遇到了另一个男人。

sentences.en: Abusive.
sentences.zh: 有虐待倾向。

sentences.en: He's also pretty abusive.
sentences.zh: 他也相当有虐待倾向。

sentences.en: And at this point, she's wise to this type of behavior and gets out of it pretty quickly.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，她已经看透了这种行为，很快就脱身了。

sentences.en: Gets in her car and drives back to Baltimore.
sentences.zh: 她坐上车，开车回到了巴尔的摩。

sentences.en: And when she gets back to Baltimore, she finds out she's pregnant.
sentences.zh: 当她回到巴尔的摩时，她发现自己怀孕了。

sentences.en: So I called down that boy and told that boy in North Carolina, he begged me to come back.
sentences.zh: 所以我给那个北卡罗来纳州的男孩打了电话，他求我回去。

sentences.en: I went down there a week before he was fighting on me again.
sentences.zh: 我刚过去一周，他又开始对我动手了。

sentences.en: I've been getting beat up by boys all my living life with having boyfriends.
sentences.zh: 我这辈子只要交男朋友，就一直在被男人打。

sentences.en: I'm not letting my child see no man be no man.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会让我的孩子看到男人那副德行。

sentences.en: Everything was about that child from the day I found out I was pregnant with him.
sentences.zh: 从我发现怀孕的那天起，我的一切都是为了那个孩子。

sentences.en: I got in my car and I came back to Baltimore.
sentences.zh: 我上了车，回到了巴尔的摩。

sentences.en: And he looked back.
sentences.zh: 他回头看了看。

sentences.en: Let me think.
sentences.zh: 让我想想。

sentences.en: When they started arresting everybody,
sentences.zh: 当他们开始逮捕所有人时，

sentences.en: well, I'm going to say, how about in the late 90s?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想说，大概是在九十年代末？

sentences.en: The 90s was hell broke loose, you know?
sentences.zh: 九十年代简直是人间地狱，你懂的。

sentences.en: And I think that's when it started in the 90s to current, which is present, which is now.
sentences.zh: 我认为是从九十年代开始一直持续到现在。

sentences.en: Tobey comes back to Baltimore and in May 1998, gives birth to Nook.
sentences.zh: 托比回到巴尔的摩，并于1998年5月生下了努克。

sentences.en: In a city with only one serious political party, it's hard to get voters excited for a two-party election.
sentences.zh: 在一个只有一个主要政党的城市，很难让选民对两党选举感到兴奋。

sentences.en: But in its way, this is a pretty dramatic moment.
sentences.zh: 但从某种程度上说，这是一个相当戏剧性的时刻。

sentences.en: It's the first time we're getting a new mayor in 12 years.
sentences.zh: 这是我们12年来第一次迎来新市长。

sentences.en: That was around the time of a really big race for mayor of the city of Baltimore that would really come to define Nook's adolescence and the world that he ended up inhabiting.
sentences.zh: 那段时间正好赶上巴尔的摩市一场非常重要的市长竞选，这场竞选真正定义了努克的青春期以及他最终所处的世界。

sentences.en: Frustrated by what's happening in our neighborhoods?
sentences.zh: 对我们社区发生的事情感到沮丧吗？

sentences.en: So is Martin O'Malley.
sentences.zh: 马丁·奥马利也是如此。

sentences.en: And that's because one candidate in particular has promised the one thing that so many people in Baltimore were really, really, really craving.
sentences.zh: 那是因为有一位候选人特别承诺了巴尔的摩许多人真正、真正、真正渴望的一件事。

sentences.en: Getting tough on drugs, getting tough on crime, and cleaning stuff up.
sentences.zh: 严厉打击毒品，严厉打击犯罪，清理一切乱象。

sentences.en: Former prosecutor, respected city councilman.
sentences.zh: 前检察官，受人尊敬的市议员。

sentences.en: For every street, O'Malley has a real plan to make our neighborhoods a safer place to live, learn, and play.
sentences.zh: 为了每一条街道，奥马利都有一个切实可行的计划，让我们的社区成为一个更安全的生活、学习和娱乐场所。

sentences.en: Martin O'Malley.
sentences.zh: 马丁·奥马利。

sentences.en: And that candidate was a city council member named Martin O'Malley.
sentences.zh: 而那位候选人是一位名叫马丁·奥马利的市议员。

sentences.en: My campaign for mayor has been about uniting the people of our city.
sentences.zh: 我竞选市长的初衷是团结我们城市的民众。

sentences.en: Uniting every neighborhood to bring about the changes we need to move forward.
sentences.zh: 团结每一个社区，以实现我们前进所需的变革。

sentences.en: Changes to make our public schools the safest and smartest places to learn.
sentences.zh: 让我们的公立学校成为最安全、最聪明的学习场所的变革。

sentences.en: Changes to make neighborhood safety and closing down open-air drug markets a top priority.
sentences.zh: 将社区安全和取缔露天毒品市场作为重中之重的变革。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that he was white, Black Baltimore really embraced him.
sentences.zh: 尽管他是白人，但巴尔的摩的黑人确实接纳了他。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, I'm thinking about character and integrity.
sentences.zh: 周二，我在思考品格和正直。

sentences.en: That's why I'm supporting Martin O'Malley.
sentences.zh: 这就是我支持马丁·奥马利的原因。

sentences.en: They wanted someone to get tough on these things because they were tired of having to live with them every day.
sentences.zh: 他们想要一个能对这些问题采取强硬手段的人，因为他们厌倦了每天忍受这些生活环境。

sentences.en: It won't happen overnight.
sentences.zh: 这不会一夜之间发生。

sentences.en: But with your vote and confidence, we can put Baltimore back on top.
sentences.zh: 但有了你们的投票和信任，我们可以让巴尔的摩重回巅峰。

sentences.en: But then it turned out really differently.
sentences.zh: 但结果却大相径庭。

sentences.en: We are taking back streets that we effectively de-policed in the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 我们正在夺回那些在20世纪70年代实际上已经放弃警力覆盖的街道。

sentences.en: We're re-policing them.
sentences.zh: 我们正在重新部署警力。

sentences.en: We're putting police back into them.
sentences.zh: 我们正在把警察派回这些地方。

sentences.en: But the police aren't just there.
sentences.zh: 但警察不仅仅是待在那里。

sentences.en: They're doing something.
sentences.zh: 他们正在采取行动。

sentences.en: Martin went to New York and what they saw was zero tolerance in its embassy stage.
sentences.zh: 马丁去了纽约，他们看到的是处于萌芽阶段的“零容忍”政策。

sentences.en: So New York at that time was experimenting with this thing called zero tolerance policy.
sentences.zh: 当时纽约正在试验一种叫做“零容忍”的政策。

sentences.en: Essentially widespread arrests for small kind of routine crimes.
sentences.zh: 本质上就是对各种琐碎的日常犯罪进行大规模逮捕。

sentences.en: We're using police to control behavior to such an extent that we are now changing it so that people who thought they could get away with drinking in public,
sentences.zh: 我们正在利用警察来控制行为，程度之深以至于我们正在改变现状，让那些以为可以在公共场合喝酒的人，

sentences.en: people who thought they could get away with urinating in public, people who thought they could ride the subways without paying their fare,
sentences.zh: 那些以为可以在公共场合随地小便的人，那些以为可以不买票就坐地铁的人，

sentences.en: are learning that somebody is going to challenge that behavior and that somebody is the police.
sentences.zh: 开始意识到会有人来制止这种行为，而那个人就是警察。

sentences.en: And at that point, it really looked like it was working.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，看起来确实奏效了。

sentences.en: It looked good, you know, because all the numbers and this and that.
sentences.zh: 看起来不错，你知道，因为所有的数据等等。

sentences.en: So O'Malley wants to try this in Baltimore.
sentences.zh: 所以奥马利想在巴尔的摩尝试这种做法。

sentences.en: But there are cops like Lou Hobson who really disagree.
sentences.zh: 但像卢·霍布森这样的警察却非常不赞同。

sentences.en: And we realized that, you know, this zero tolerance is going to be a disaster.
sentences.zh: 我们意识到，你知道，这种“零容忍”将会是一场灾难。

sentences.en: All you're going to do is put black marks on people's record.
sentences.zh: 你所做的只是给人们的记录上留下污点。

sentences.en: You know, I appealed to Martin myself.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我亲自向马丁呼吁过。

sentences.en: I said, Martin, listen, if you bring a zero tolerance here in four or five years from now, I said, it's going to be so unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 我说，马丁，听着，如果你在四五年后把“零容忍”带到这里，我说，那将是不可思议的糟糕。

sentences.en: You have corrupt police officers right and left.
sentences.zh: 你会到处都是腐败的警察。

sentences.en: You can't give this kind of authority to a police department and just say, look, you guys go do what you want.
sentences.zh: 你不能给警察部门这种权力，然后就说，看，你们想干什么就干什么。

sentences.en: Not without some type of, you know, checks and balances and everything.
sentences.zh: 不能在没有任何制衡机制的情况下这样做。

sentences.en: Well, they did.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们确实这么做了。

sentences.en: So Martin O'Malley brings someone down from New York City to run the Baltimore police force.
sentences.zh: 于是马丁·奥马利从纽约市找来一个人来管理巴尔的摩警察局。

sentences.en: You see, they went or walking down the street.
sentences.zh: 你看，他们走在街上。

sentences.en: They were arresting people on their way to work, even kids just out playing.
sentences.zh: 他们在人们上班的路上逮捕他们，甚至逮捕那些只是出来玩的孩子。

sentences.en: Seven-year-old Gerard Mungo Jr.
sentences.zh: 七岁的杰拉德·蒙戈二世。

sentences.en: was handcuffed, arrested and booked.
sentences.zh: 被戴上手铐，逮捕并登记在案。

sentences.en: He says he was sitting on his dirt bike with the motor off in front of his East Federal Street house.
sentences.zh: 他说他当时正坐在东联邦街家门前的越野摩托车上，引擎是熄火的。

sentences.en: A police officer returned to his house, handcuffed him, put him in a caged police car and took him to the Eastern District before sending him to juvenile booking.
sentences.zh: 一名警察回到他家，给他戴上手铐，把他关进警车，带到东区警局，然后送往少年拘留所。

sentences.en: My son got pulled over quite a few times, but he was walking.
sentences.zh: 我儿子被拦下过好几次，但他当时是在走路。

sentences.en: He don't drive.
sentences.zh: 他不开车。

sentences.en: DeVetta's son was picked up by the police many times, not for having done anything illegal, but just stopped walking down the sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 德维塔的儿子被警察抓过很多次，不是因为他做了什么违法的事，仅仅是因为他走在人行道上就被拦下了。

sentences.en: Oh, but anyway, they would just drive up in their car and stop in front of him like this.
sentences.zh: 哦，总之，他们会直接开车过来，像这样停在他面前。

sentences.en: And tell him, sit down, get on the floor, get on the ground.
sentences.zh: 然后告诉他，坐下，趴在地上，趴在地上。

sentences.en: And they would test, you know, or pull him over in their cars and stuff.
sentences.zh: 他们会测试，你知道，或者用他们的车把他拦在路边之类的。

sentences.en: That was around about that time.
sentences.zh: 那大约是在那个时候。

sentences.en: Do you remember that happening to your son for the first time and being surprised?
sentences.zh: 你还记得你儿子第一次遇到这种情况时感到惊讶吗？

sentences.en: When it first happened to him, yeah, I was surprised.
sentences.zh: 当它第一次发生在他身上时，是的，我很惊讶。

sentences.en: But after my son told me, it happened to him like three or four times.
sentences.zh: 但在我儿子告诉我之后，这种情况发生在他身上大概有三四次了。

sentences.en: And they didn't find out more of him, so they let him go.
sentences.zh: 他们没在他身上发现什么，所以就放了他。

sentences.en: But the point was, couldn't no black young man walk down the street without being pulled over?
sentences.zh: 但重点是，难道没有一个年轻的黑人男子能走在街上而不被拦下吗？

sentences.en: Well, honestly, it was arrest, arrest, arrest, arreSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，就是逮捕，逮捕，逮捕，逮捕。

sentences.en: And people were saying, this is going to reduce crime.
sentences.zh: 人们当时说，这会减少犯罪。

sentences.en: This is rounding up everybody.
sentences.zh: 这是在把所有人都抓起来。

sentences.en: The cells were full.
sentences.zh: 牢房都满了。

sentences.en: There is a wall.
sentences.zh: 有一堵墙。

sentences.en: It became more problematic.
sentences.zh: 这变得更加成问题了。

sentences.en: Press Secretary Sarah Huckabee Sanders was asked about the president's claim that he could pardon himself.
sentences.zh: 新闻秘书Sarah Huckabee Sanders被问及总统关于他可以赦免自己的说法。

sentences.en: The president hasn't done anything wrong.

sentences.en: I guess the question is, does the president believe the framers envisioned a system where the president couldn't pardon himself, but the president could be above the law?

sentences.en: Certainly the Constitution very clearly lays out the law.

sentences.en: And once again, the president hasn't done anything wrong.

sentences.en: And we feel very comfortable in that front.
